prompt: keyTyped() never prints anything for arrow keys. Why?
choices: getKeyChar() is only valid in keyPressed()
Arrow keys do not produce a Unicode character, so keyTyped() is never fired for them
Arrow keys require a separate ArrowKeyListener
explanation: keyTyped() only fires when a printable Unicode character is produced. Arrow keys, Shift, Ctrl, function keys do not produce characters, so keyTyped is never called for them. Use keyPressed() with e.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_LEFT / VK_RIGHT / VK_UP / VK_DOWN instead.
